dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: #If it isn't my favorite client, {NICKNAME}! It's been a while, how are things?

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: ...Hmm, by the looks of it, nowhere near dire enough for you to be needing my services. *sigh* A shame, no Mora to be made here...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>How do you like it here?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Great! Very well! I feel right at home, actually.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Maybe you've forgotten, but this whole Sub-Space Creation thing is nothing new to me.

choices.text: So... you must be able to make your own one of these, right?

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Well... it can be a little...

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: ...I—It's not my forte, okay!?

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Anyway, I'm all settled in here now. Making my own would just be redundant.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: You should worry about yourself, not me.

choices.text: Then does the mighty and illuminated Yanfei have any suggestions?

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: One does, as a matter of fact! One thinks you should create a few rooms specifically for housing legal codices.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: But this is your home, of course. The rules are yours to decide.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Would you like to have a chat with me?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Chat? Oh, I don't know about you, but I can chat, for sure! Good luck trying to get me to stop talking...

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: You seem like the quiet type, are you sure you won't find me too... animated?

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Oh... good!

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: I'm not sure why, but it's nice to hear you say that.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: In that case, why don't you choose a topic?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Well then... let's chat about difficult clients of yours.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Huh? Of all the interesting topics you could choose, that's what you wanna talk about?

choices.text: Most of the time you successfully win them over.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Oh... I—I see.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Thank you...

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Ahem, then I'll start with a client who came to me with a civil case recently...

choices.text: This way, we can figure out any outstanding issues.
I'm quite happy just to listen.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Uh... Just to listen?

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: I don't think one person talking technically qualifies as a chat, per se...

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: I'm no storyteller after all — I already found my calling in life. I don't plan on spinning yarns for a living any time soon.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Is there anything you'd like to do?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Actually, I was thinking... Do you want to come fishing with me?

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Just the two of us, no one else. Not even your little friend here.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Why not? Well, if you must know...

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: It's no fun fishing by myself. No matter how many I catch, I only ever get to share them with Granny.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Because, as you know, I can't reveal my true power in front of clients or friends.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: So whichever way you look at it, it seems you're the only suitable candidate there is.

choices.text: Feels more like I'm a last resort than an ideal candidate...

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: No, no!

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Argh... Okay, okay. I just want to get out and have some fun with you.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Peacefully, without anyone else interrupting. Just the two of us...

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: You'll have a chance to see what I'm truly capable of, not just professionally...

choices.text: I never doubted you in the first place...

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Oh, really...?

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Then it's settled! I should warn you though, I have a tendency to view arrangements like these as contracts... No ducking out.

choices.text: But I am pretty good at fishing myself.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Oh ho? Well then, if I wasn't fired up before, I certainly am now!

choices.text: Feels like you're making this up as you go along...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Morning, Yanfei.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Hey! Morning!

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: You should show a little more enthusiasm, like me! Hehe!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good night, Yanfei.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: #Night night, {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: I—If you dream of any legal loopholes, I wanna know all the details as soon as you wake up!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a chat with me?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything you'd like to do?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: I didn't know you had such a knack for home décor. This bedroom is quite suitable.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Speaking of the decorations, did you shop around to compare prices? And did you make sure that the artisan fees were at fair market rates?

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Take me along next time you go shopping for furniture. I'll help you check all of that so you don't unexpectedly overpay for anything.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: You wouldn't see any operational mistakes in this commercial area even during a busy festival season.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: I can tell that you've put a great deal of time into this.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Do you plan to attract more shops? I can provide you with legal support.
